name: omnilab/usgs
description: Omnilab USGS: an earthquake of the USGS catalogue (ComCat) by its event id - magnitude and type, place, depth, time, felt reports and intensities (DYFI, ShakeMap), tsunami flag, PAGER alert level, its ids in the other networks - and the earthquakes of a box or around a point over a period as series (count per step, each one's magnitude or depth, or the step's maximum, mean...) or as a list of entities with their time and place, through the FDSN event web service, no key needed.
